placement: Optional Renderer — src/renderer/: a small template-HTML reader and writer, the kernel's binding rules applied to a tree instead of a live DOM, and a server loop that initializes the engine with the request's location, offers only Http, answers every browser-only request explicitly, and renders the settled projection. The same engine drives CSR and SSR/SSG; there is no second state authority and no BrowserKernel dependency. Streaming is not built: no measured use case yet. Core unchanged.
